Meet summer, meet sincere you ^_^

This is "MeetSummer App", and some romance I want to share with you: the main color of the app comes from a sunset in summer.

I want to talk about the original intention of this product, and what kind of atmosphere I hope it can create.

The Internet has become very mature today. But there is a sad fact that it has not brought people closer together, but instead made everyone an island. We walk alone on our own roads, and turn around to find no one around.

It must be happy to have company on the road of life. That's why we need to socialize and find people who are compatible with us.

I have to admit that there are many other social products on the market. But they all have one thing in common: they encourage you to bravely show yourself this side and that side, they encourage you to show your appearance and material conditions.

But not everyone has such courage. Compared to external conditions, I care more about spiritual resonance. I don't like to show my external conditions publicly. I believe there are many ignored, silent people who are like me.

So this is the reason why MeetSummer app was born. I hope it is a truly belonging app for people with social anxiety. I hope it can create an environment that makes you feel relaxed and comfortable, and help you find truly compatible people with as little exposure of external conditions as possible.

To create such an environment, you don't need to fill in a lot of profiles, you can't send pictures and voice during the chat. Even more, you can only chat with one person at a time.

But of course these are not enough. I hope everyone can realize that the other person is a person just like themselves, who deserves respect and should be treated politely. So please treat others kindly and make a good use of the reporting feature. This way a relaxed and comfortable environment can be maintained for a long time.

~

What is MeetSummer app?

- MeetSummer is a tree-hole chat app for people with social anxiety.
- Astrology and MBTI matches help you find people on the same frequency.
- Match with a stranger anonymously, no chat history, no pressure.
- Instant match, you will get a response in the moment.
- Pure text chat, no pictures or voice messages.
- You can only chat with one person at a time, which is not friendly to scumbags.
- Machine and human double reporting mechanism, help you maintain a healthy and polite chat environment.

It's really not a messy app. If you encounter rude people, please tap report without mercy, they will be automatically banned.

I hope this little app can make you brave enough to try constantly, and finally help you find the summer that lights up your heart.
